anegy.title: Anegy
anegy.description: A movie and series platform featuring favorites, watched lists, a generator, and advanced search and filtering options.
anegy.about: Anegy is a personal project that allows visitors to discover, save, and keep track of movies and series. The website uses the TMDB API and includes features such as favorites, watched lists, and a movie and series generator. Users can also search and filter by movies, series, and people. The application supports both Dutch and English and offers both light and dark mode support.

highlights.tmdb: Movies and series are retrieved through the TMDB database.

account.title: Account features
account.text: Users can manage favorites and watched lists.

generator.title: Generator
generator.text: A generator helps users discover new movies and series.

lmtapes.title: LMTAPES
lmtapes.description: A creative portfolio for Lisa-Marij, the animator and illustrator behind LMTAPES. A space where animation, illustration and distinctive visual stories come together.
lmtapes.about: For LMTAPES, I developed a portfolio website using React and Tailwind that puts Lisa-Marij’s work centre stage. Her animations and illustrations explore atmosphere, character and imagination: familiar worlds with a strange or unexpected twist. The website reflects this through a distinctive design and a visual project overview. Visitors can filter the work by animation and illustration and explore each project on its own detail page. The website is available in Dutch and English.

portfolio.title: The work takes centre stage
portfolio.text: A visual project overview with filters for animation and illustration. Dedicated project pages provide space for the story and imagery behind each piece.

design.title: A distinctive visual identity
design.text: Teal gradients, large imagery and contrasting typography reflect the creative world of LMTAPES and give the portfolio a recognisable character.

multilingual.title: Dutch and English
multilingual.text: A language switch lets visitors browse the website in Dutch or English, from the navigation to the project descriptions.

montiraMassage.title: Montira Massage
montiraMassage.description: A modern website for a massage salon with an integrated online appointment system.
montiraMassage.about: Montira Massage is a website developed for a massage salon with a focus on calmness, appearance, and usability. The website was built using WordPress and Elementor and includes an online booking system powered by Bookly, allowing visitors to easily schedule appointments.

wordpress.title: WordPress & Elementor
wordpress.text: The website was built with WordPress and Elementor for flexible management and customization.

booking.title: Online appointments
booking.text: Visitors can easily schedule appointments through the integrated Bookly system.

design.title: Calm appearance
design.text: The website was designed with a focus on calmness, atmosphere, and usability.

jewelryBySil.description: A trendy webshop for jewelry and clothing, built with WordPress and WooCommerce.
jewelryBySil.about: Jewelry by Sil is a webshop for jewelry and clothing with a trendy and stylish look. The webshop was built with WordPress and WooCommerce, making it easy to manage products and allowing visitors to shop with ease.

woocommerce.text: The webshop was built with WooCommerce for product management, cart functionality, and orders.

design.title: Trendy look

thaiWokToGo.title: Thai Wok To Go
thaiWokToGo.description: A modern React website for a Thai restaurant, featuring a responsive design, intuitive navigation, and a clear digital menu.
thaiWokToGo.about: Thai Wok To Go is a modern restaurant website built with React and Tailwind CSS. The previous WordPress website was completely redesigned and rebuilt from scratch, resulting in a faster, more responsive, and visually appealing experience. Visitors can easily browse the menu, find opening hours, and navigate to the restaurant through the integrated map.

react.title: React & Tailwind
react.text: The website was rebuilt from WordPress using React and Tailwind CSS for a fast, modern, and responsive user experience.

design.title: Modern design
design.text: A complete visual redesign with a clean layout, smooth navigation, and mobile-first responsive design.

maps.title: Maps integration
maps.text: Visitors can quickly find the restaurant and plan their route using the integrated Google Maps.

sonsOfTheSeaCustoms.title: Sons of the Sea Customs
sonsOfTheSeaCustoms.description: A WooCommerce webshop for MCC Sons of the Sea merchandise with animations, multiple languages, and Instagram integration.
sonsOfTheSeaCustoms.about: Sons of the Sea Customs is a webshop developed for MCC Sons of the Sea to sell merchandise. The webshop was built with WordPress and WooCommerce and includes various animations to give the website a lively appearance. The website also supports multiple languages, including Dutch, English, and German. In addition, Instagram posts from MCC Sons of the Sea are displayed on the website.

woocommerce.title: WooCommerce webshop
woocommerce.text: The webshop was built with WooCommerce for product management, orders, and payments.

animations.title: Dynamic animations
animations.text: Various animations create a dynamic and modern user experience.

languages.title: Multiple languages

spekulaasplanken.title: Spekulaasplanken
spekulaasplanken.description: A multilingual catalogue website for handmade and antique speculaas moulds, featuring a traditional design and a clear product presentation.
spekulaasplanken.about: Spekulaasplanken is a modern catalogue website created to showcase handmade and antique speculaas moulds. The website was developed with React and Tailwind and features a warm, traditional appearance that reflects the craftsmanship behind the products. Visitors can explore the different speculaas moulds, learn more about baking speculaas and easily get in touch by phone, email or WhatsApp. The complete website is available in Dutch, English and German.

catalogue.title: Clear product catalogue
catalogue.text: Handmade and antique speculaas moulds are presented clearly with photographs and relevant product information.

design.title: Traditional design
design.text: Warm colours, classic typography and carefully selected photography give the website an authentic and traditional appearance.

languages.title: Three languages
languages.text: The complete website is available in Dutch, English and German, making the collection accessible to a wider audience.

everlastingWild.title: Everlasting Wild

everlastingWild.about: Everlasting Wild is my own business website for offering custom websites and web applications. The website was developed with React and Tailwind and combines a distinctive visual identity with a modern and user-friendly interface. Visitors are given a clear overview of my projects, technical skills and services. The website is fully responsive and available in Dutch and English.

design.title: Distinctive visual identity

projects.title: Projects and services

languages.title: Multilingual website
